title: 2 arrested, P6.8M in suspected meth seized in Sulu drug sting

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Two individuals were arrested, and about a kilogram of suspected “shabu” or crystal meth was seized in a buy-bust operation in Indanan, Sulu on Thursday evening. Director Bryan Babang, Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA)-9 regional chief, said operatives from the PDEA Sulu Provincial Office and various Philippine National Police (PNP) units carried out the operation at around 6:30 p.m. in Barangay Kajatian. The arrested individuals were identified as alias “Alsidar”, 29, a delivery rider and resident of Maimbung, Sulu, and alias “Norudun,” 27, a resident of Kuttong, Talipao, Sulu.
